Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, most jobs touch more than one category. Here's where to start outside and in, with the one question to settle before ordering each.

Exterior

Shutters

Vinyl, wood or composite. Measure every window; vinyl and wood shutters are made to order and can't be returned.

Gable vents

Size it to the gable, and check the product page for whether it's functional or decorative.

Columns

Confirm whether it needs to be load-bearing, then check height and diameter against the product specs.

Balustrades

Railing kits. Measure the full run between posts before you order.

 

Interior

Faux wood beams

Timberthane, maintenance-free. Heritage Series ships in 24-72 hours; custom sizes through the beam builder.

Shop now →

Mantels

Measure the firebox opening and check clearances before you pick a size.

Moulding

Order the full run plus extra for cuts, and check a profile sample first.

Shop now →

Ceiling medallions

Size it to the room and the light fixture it frames.
